hero.title: Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin
hero.heading: Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin
hero.intro: The Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin sets a new standard for all‑weather boating. It seamlessly shifts from a fully enclosed, protective cabin to an open, social space in seconds, without breaking the connection to the surroundings. Every detail serves a purpose, from the refined hull to the flexible layout, delivering confident handling, efficiency, and comfort in changing conditions. Built without compromise, it adapts to how you use your time on the water, making every journey feel effortless and every moment more accessible.

sections.title: Configure Your Axopar 38
sections.intro: Explore a range of layouts and power options. Additional models coming soon.

sections.title: Unparalleled Driveability
sections.intro: Discover new bow geometry, improved weight distribution, and a re-engineered hull profile.

sections.title: The Boat That's Safe – and Smart
sections.intro: Wide walkways, a deep cockpit, smart navigation, and boat health assessment features ensure peace of mind.

sections.title: Reimagined Hydrodynamics and Balance for Effortless Control and Agility
sections.intro: Hydrodynamic and weight distribution improvements add an even greater sense of confidence at the helm, where optimized strength-to-weight through overbuilt stringer systems ensures rigid structural integrity. This gives boaters the assurance that the 38 behaves exactly as expected, calm and precise, regardless of who is at the helm or what conditions lie ahead, making it equally enjoyable for experienced captains and those new to boating.

sections.title: Extensively Engineered Noise Reduction Solutions for Added Comfort Onboard
sections.intro: Keeping the hull more rigid prevents unwanted flex that can transmit sound throughout the boat. This creates a quieter, more refined ride, with hull resonance minimized and conversations staying clear even at speed. The result is a noticeably smoother and more comfortable experience for everyone on board.

sections.title: Refined, Functional Design with Great Attention to Details and Meaningful Innovations
sections.intro: Every element onboard follows Axopar’s principle of intelligent design, where nothing is added without purpose. Clean lines, efficient use of space, and modular layouts ensure everything works together to support a better experience on the water.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

sections.title: Tailored for Year-round Operation Extending Seasonal Use and Maximizing Time on the Water
sections.intro: Designed to handle shifting weather and colder seasons with confidence, the boat provides a dependable platform whenever conditions change. Protected spaces and efficient hull performance ensure you can explore earlier in spring, stay out later in autumn, and enjoy more days on the water overall. This approach reflects Axopar’s philosophy of building boats for real environments and real boaters who want capability that lasts throughout the entire year.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin comes with a spacious open aft deck. You can also equip the aft deck with an optional Aft Deck Bench, Wet Bar, Dinette, or Aft Cabin/Multi-Storage Compartment.

items.caption: The aft deck is designed to support a wide range of activities and adapt to your needs. Optional foldable activity platforms make watersports, swimming, social gatherings, or practical gear loading easier, while expanding the deck and improving water access.

The reimagined bow creates a genuine social space that adapts to different uses. Owners can choose between standard forward-facing seating or upgrade to a U-sofa with a table that converts into a sunbed, or opt for a fixed extended sun lounge.

The helm offers clear visibility and intuitive ergonomics for confident control. Two rotating seats, or the Driver's Sofa, let the driver and co-driver face the social area, creating a natural connection between driving and interaction onboard.

The wheelhouse is a space for relaxing and socializing. Two sofas and a fixed table come standard, and options like a U-sofa or a reversible driver’s sofa create a dining area or lounge. Sliding doors, an aft window, and a canvas roof bring in fresh air.

The front cabin is bright and spacious with higher headroom, skylights, and gullwing doors. The bed converts to a lounge, and a new optional kitchen module adds storage and appliance space. Optional features include an enclosed toilet with a shower and warm water.

sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.

items.name: The Most Modular Boat
items.title: The Most Modular Boat
items.text: The Axopar 38 offers the widest range of configurations in its class. Customers can optimize every area more closely to their own preferences, while competitors offer only standard compromises. With comprehensive layout options, this flexibility offers greater freedom and fewer compromises, enabling a level of adaptability never before available.

items.name: Total Control
items.title: Total Control
items.text: With an uncompromising drive to innovate, the all‑new Axopar 38 redefines onboard comfort and livability while delivering an exceptional driving experience on one of the best‑handling hulls in the world. It is the most ambitious and impactful Axopar range to date, created to make boating easier, safer, and more enjoyable for both seasoned boaters and newcomers.

items.name: Rigid, Lightweight Strength
items.title: Rigid, Lightweight Strength
items.text: By minimizing flex and vibration, the stringers create a solid, stable platform that improves handling, comfort, and safety at every speed. The added stiffness distributes impact loads more effectively in rough water, reduces long‑term hull fatigue, and protects other components from unnecessary stress. The result is a stronger, quieter, and more durable boat that delivers consistent performance season after season.

items.name: No Compromise
items.title: No Compromise
items.text: Axopar believes a boat should adapt to different uses with minimal compromise, especially as today’s boating is broader, more social, and more versatile than ever. People spend longer days on the water and use their boat for a wider range of activities. The all‑new Axopar 38 is built for exactly that. It is the result of Axopar’s most extensive R&D investment to date, continuing the brand’s commitment to functional, flexible, and timeless Nordic design that enables real experiences without unnecessary complexity.

items.name: Pure Function
items.title: Pure Function
items.text: The boat is designed for frequent, real-world use, simple to maintain, ensuring practical durability and functional purity without the distraction of gimmicks or superficial complexity.

items.name: Made by Boaters
items.title: Made by Boaters
items.text: The design, layout, and functionality come from real on‑water experience. Every detail reflects what boaters genuinely need, from smart storage and safe movement onboard to predictable, dependable handling in any conditions. Every feature has a purpose, and every decision supports a better, more enjoyable time on the water.

items.name: Activity Platforms
items.title: Activity Platforms
items.text: The foldable Activity Platforms expand the aft deck into a larger, more versatile space that adapts to whatever the day brings. When opened, they create a wider area for watersports, swimming, and social gatherings, giving everyone more room to move comfortably around the stern. Designed to enhance both functionality and freedom of movement, the platforms add real usability to the aft deck and elevate the overall experience onboard.

items.name: Bench Seats
items.title: Bench Seats
items.text: A fenderbox can be more than just storage. Choose the optional Fenderbox Bench Seats with storage to transform it into a comfortable place to unwind. It adds extra seating and creates a natural spot for socializing, making the most of every moment on the water.

items.name: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.title: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.text: The very popular Wet Bar in Fenderbox offers a convenient outdoor galley with features like a sink with faucet and refrigerator, all integrated into the fender storage compartment, ideal for entertaining and enhancing usability.

items.name: Enclosed Toilet
items.title: Enclosed Toilet
items.text: The enclosed toilet in the front cabin adds everyday practicality and comfort for longer days on the water. The compartment offers generous standing height and a clean, modern design that integrates naturally into the cabin layout. Optional warm water and shower capability further expands onboard usability, making the space suitable for quick freshen‑ups.

items.name: Pentry Module
items.title: Pentry Module
items.text: The Pentry Module adds practical convenience to the front cabin with dedicated space for a fridge and coffee machine. With an optional drawer fridge and cooktop, it supports quick meals and refreshments without taking up valuable cabin space. Its clean, efficient layout keeps everyday essentials easily accessible, enhancing comfort on longer days afloat.

items.name: Wheelhouse Lounge
items.title: Wheelhouse Lounge
items.text: The reimagined wheelhouse is the social heart of the 38. Its flexible lounge layout creates a bright, comfortable space where everyone can gather, relax, and enjoy the journey. With generous seating, clever storage, and a smooth flow between the helm and the aft section, the wheelhouse is designed for long days on the water. Whether you are sharing a meal, cruising at speed, or taking shelter from changing conditions, the lounge offers a calm and connected environment that enhances life onboard.

items.name: Openable Aft Window
items.title: Openable Aft Window
items.text: The optional openable aft window transforms the wheelhouse by creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. When opened, it brings fresh air into the interior and enhances visibility, making the entire boat feel more spacious and open. It supports social interaction between the wheelhouse and the aft deck, and improves natural ventilation on warm days. The design keeps the cabin bright, airy, and adaptable throughout the season.

items.name: Driver's Sofa
items.title: Driver's Sofa
items.text: The optional Driver’s Sofa Upgrade introduces a wide, supportive seating arrangement for the helm area. A reversible backrest and flip‑up bolsters allow the driver to switch easily between relaxed cruising and an active driving stance. The design improves long‑distance comfort while maintaining excellent ergonomics and visibility. It enhances the wheelhouse's overall usability, giving the driver and co‑driver more space and a pleasant seating experience on every trip.

items.name: U-Sofa in Bow
items.title: U-Sofa in Bow
items.text: The U‑sofa package transforms the bow into a true social zone. The wraparound seating creates an inviting space for conversations, meals, and relaxed cruising, while the central table supports dining and entertainment. The layout can also convert into a full sunbed, giving the bow multiple functions for different situations. With its open feel and multiple configuration options, the bow becomes one of the most versatile and enjoyable spaces onboard.

items.name: Gullwing Doors
items.title: Gullwing Doors
items.text: The iconic Gullwing Doors open the forward cabin to the outside, letting in fresh air and natural light. They make stepping in and out effortless and turn the cabin into an inviting space to relax when anchored or docked.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 38 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: Experience the ultimate expression of power, style, and exclusivity with the BRABUS Performance Line. Designed for boaters who seek more from every journey, this upgrade combines the impressive performance of twin Mercury V10 425 hp engines with signature BRABUS styling details for an unmistakable presence on the water. The result is faster acceleration, greater responsiveness, and a more engaging driving experience, complemented by exclusive design elements that set your boat apart.
